Since 2011, Gregory FARAUT is with the Dept. of Mechanical Engineering of ENS Paris-Saclay, University of Paris-Saclay (France). He is currently involved in the teaching of the following courses at graduate levels.

My teaching duty is currently about 320h/year (face-to-face with students) 



## Discrete Event Systems (DES)

- Language Theory
- Event-driven System
- Automata Theory
- Supervisory Control Theory

## Performance of industrial systems

- Petri Nets
- Timed Petri Nets
- Colored Petri Net 
- Synthesis of Petri Nets
- Petri Nets simulation



## Diagnostic and verification

- Diagnostic frameworks for DES
- Probabilistic Petri Nets
- Hybrid Petri Nets
- Model-checking
- Tests generation



## Optimization and AI

- Linear Programming (LP)
- Integer-Linear Programming (ILP, MILP)
- Non-Linear Programming (Quasi-Newton method, BFGS, etc.)
- Heuristic (Simulated annealing, Genetic Algo, etc.)
- AI techniques (basics : RNN, LLM, etc.)

## Linear Control Theory - basics

- Control of continuous systems (Fourier-Laplace Transform)
- MIMO system, stability
- Controller Synthesis (Basics and advanced controler)
- Discrete-timed continuous system
